   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Oct 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Cat Top_, Oct 17, 2026, 1/5: "full of bugs keeps crashing"
            2. _Michael Nevradakis_, Oct 14, 2026, 1/5: "2026 update: Frequently freezes/stops working on my Android phone, often requiring a force stop, or in some cases, reinstallation. Notes don't always sync, or sync quickly, from other devices. Even when "working," app often slow. I'm a pair customer and the price isn't cheap. Do better."
            3. _Kay Coughlin_, Oct 13, 2026, 1/5: "Edited 10.13.26: newest version of app does not let me access anything except keyboard. I can't access camera or import files. I can't even bold text or put in a bulleted list. Evernote is an amazing service. It has become my brain's external memory. I have been a premium user for many, many years and only recently have bugs become this serious. I use the app all day long, every day. What's going on, Evernote?!"
